structured.answer: I'll ask my son or the bank before I move anything. If I had to point at something, it would be a "גמל אג"ח ממשלות" track, like מיטב's at "0.52%" with 0% in shares, because I know government bonds are safe. But much of the page I couldn't understand.

stuck.why: "נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026" made me doubt whether the numbers can be trusted
Not sure if "4.9%" for 3 years is per year or for all three years
Two fees per row ("ההיסכון" and "ההפקדה") with no explanation of what I'd actually pay
Long dark lists of numbers, eyes tired, stopped at the start of אנליסט

used: Company names: מיטב, מור, הפניקס, אלטשולר שחם, כלל, הראל
Track names with אג"ח ממשלות / כספי (שקלי) / אשראי ואג"ח
skimmed: Rows of share and S&P tracks
Company summary bars (כסף מנוהל, דמי ניהול range)
unsure_meaning: עוקב מדדים, עוקב מדדי מניות, גמיש
תשואה שנתית ממוצעת לפני דמי ניהול
not_found: A plain sentence saying which track is safe like a deposit
Explanation of what the two fees mean in shekels
Which track suits someone my age

findings.what: Dark background with thin, pale grey text that is hard to read even enlarged
Same labels (ההיסכון, ההפקדה, מניות, מט"ח, 3 שנים, 5 שנים) repeated on every row; I had to reread them each time to find what differs
Warning that the data was not updated since September 2026 undermines trust right at the top
Coloured dots for מניות/מט"ח match the ring chart only by colour; colours close and I couldn't match them
Huge list (182 tracks) with no simple guidance for a cautious saver
Percentages over 100% (101%, 103%) are confusing and alarming
English letters (S&P500) and jargon (עוקב מדדים, גמיש) in track names
Unexplained orange "!" and "עוד לא דווח" look like warnings
